categories.main_business_segments: Leascend Technology primarily operates in the photovoltaic (PV) solar cell industry, focusing on high-efficiency heterojunction (HJT) solar cells and modules. Additionally, the company engages in mobile communication resale services and enterprise information technology services, including software applications and internet services. It also has a segment for property leasing, mainly managing a technology park in Tianjin.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in HJT solar cell technology, which combines crystalline silicon wafers with amorphous silicon thin films to achieve high conversion efficiency and low degradation. Key technological features include large-size G12 half-cut wafers, zero busbar (0BB) technology, silver-coated copper paste, and thin silicon wafers (down to 100 microns). The production process emphasizes low temperature, simplified steps, and cost reduction through innovations like low silver content and indium-free target materials. The company also develops tandem perovskite solar cells stacked on HJT cells to push efficiency beyond 32%.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Leascend serves domestic and international PV module manufacturers and solar power project developers, supplying high-efficiency HJT solar cells. Its mobile communication resale business targets individual and enterprise end-users in China. The company’s PV products are recognized by major domestic and overseas customers, including leading PV module companies. The company is expanding into emerging overseas markets such as the Middle East, Africa, and India, leveraging its technology’s patent independence to avoid international patent barriers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Sichuan (Meishan) and Jiangsu (Nantong). It serves domestic markets extensively and is actively expanding exports and market presence in emerging international markets including Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and India. The company’s sales are predominantly domestic (~87%) with growing export sales (~13%).
categories.supply_chain_position: Leascend operates in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of high-efficiency solar cells and modules. It procures upstream raw materials such as silicon wafers and silver paste and supplies downstream PV module manufacturers and system integrators. The company also integrates vertically by developing related technologies and expanding into downstream markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on advancing HJT solar cell technology to improve conversion efficiency and reduce production costs. R&D priorities include ultra-thin wafer processing, silver-coated copper paste, zero busbar technology, and tandem perovskite-HJT cells. It emphasizes innovation to maintain technological leadership and cost competitiveness. The company also plans to expand capacity, optimize production, and pursue industry chain integration and mergers and acquisitions to strengthen market position.
categories.revenue_model: Leascend generates revenue primarily through the sale of photovoltaic solar cells and modules under a self-produced and self-sold model. It also earns income from mobile communication resale services by purchasing telecom services from operators and reselling to end customers. Additionally, revenue streams include enterprise IT services and property leasing. The company recognizes revenue at the point of product delivery or service provision based on control transfer.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Leascend is positioned as a representative enterprise in the high-efficiency HJT solar cell segment, competing with other leading Chinese PV cell manufacturers specializing in N-type cell technologies such as TOPCon and PERC. It leverages its patent independence in HJT technology to mitigate international patent risks and aims to capture the growing 210mm wafer market niche. The company is recognized as a key member of industry alliances and holds a competitive position in both domestic and emerging international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Leascend reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 500.55 million, a 121.79% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by the ramp-up of solar cell production. However, the company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 110.32 million due to high costs and price declines in the PV market. Total assets stood at about RMB 3.3 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing capacity expansion projects totaling 20GW planned, but profitability is currently challenged by market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Leascend emphasizes its high-efficiency HJT solar cells with conversion efficiencies exceeding 26%, leveraging advanced technologies like zero busbar and silver-coated copper paste to reduce costs and improve performance. Its products feature lower degradation rates, superior temperature coefficients, and higher bifaciality, resulting in greater energy yield and lower carbon footprint compared to traditional PERC and TOPCon cells. The company’s proprietary technology and patent portfolio provide a competitive edge, enabling it to avoid patent barriers and expand globally, especially in emerging markets.
